name: columbus-business-tracker
description: Investment dashboard tracking businesses for sale and sold in Columbus, Ohio and surrounding counties.

scripts.dev: npm run seed --workspace server && concurrently -n api,web "npm run dev --workspace server" "npm run dev --workspace web"
scripts.build:static: npm run sources -- export-static ../web/public/tracker.db && npm run build:static --workspace web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace server && npm run typecheck --workspace web
